benefits.name: 100% Disabled Veteran Property Tax Exemption
benefits.description: Veterans rated 100% service-connected disabled by the VA receive property tax exemption on their primary residence.
benefits.howToApply: Apply with your county tax assessor. Submit VA rating letter showing 100% disability, DD-214, and proof of residency.

legalCitations.description: Property tax exemption for 100% disabled veterans

benefits.name: Disabled Veteran License Plates
benefits.description: Veterans with service-connected disabilities can obtain special DV license plates with reduced or waived registration fees.
benefits.howToApply: Visit your local DMV office. Submit VA rating letter and DD-214.

benefits.name: Hunting and Fishing License Discount
benefits.description: Disabled veterans receive discounted or free hunting and fishing licenses in Montana.
benefits.howToApply: Purchase licenses from any vendor or online. Show VA rating letter for discount.
